通常モード：接続、処理時間、再試行、エラーの要約を自動保存します。\nデバッグモ:
Normal mode automatically saves connection events, operation timings, retries and errors.
Debug mode also records full MIDI, raw driver chunks, buffer state and UI delays.
If a problem occurs, note the time and share the ZIP from "Export diagnostic logs". No restart is needed.
